_rules: An agent may only flip `passes` from false to true, and only after actually running `verify` and seeing it pass. Never edit `description`. Never delete an entry.

features.description: The full package selftest passes: JSON, manifest schema, hook shape, shell syntax, skill frontmatter, and a live gate test
A staged file outside .brain/plans/ACTIVE.scope is rejected by the pre-commit hook
features.verify: bash bin/selftest.sh 2>&1 | grep -q 'PASS out-of-scope commit blocked'

features.description: plugin.json and marketplace.json are accepted by the real Claude Code schema validator
install.sh installs the gate into a fresh git repo and sets core.hooksPath
features.verify: T=$(mktemp -d) && cd $T && git init -q . && bash $OLDPWD/install.sh --skip-plugin >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ "$(git config core.hooksPath)" = .githooks ]

features.description: The brain-verify workflow's 'verify' job passes on main
features.verify: gh run list --repo harsh-matchmyflight/project-brain --limit 1 --json conclusion -q '.[0].conclusion' | grep -q success
